definitions: To make (a garment, fabric, etc.) by interlocking loops of yarn or thread with needles.
To join or interlace (threads, parts, etc.) closely and firmly.
To draw together; to contract into wrinkles.
To unite closely; to connect firmly.
examples: She likes to knit sweaters for her grandchildren.
The bones will knit together over time.
He knit his brows in concentration.
Their families were knit together by marriage.
